text:
The Tract II survey covered many sections in Townships 1 and 2 North, Ranges 36 and 37 East. The 1975 survey by the Fredlunds listed following 35 sites:
24BH151  Open occupation-observation site, 35 by 35 meters, lying on the rim of a bench. Lithic material was sparse with 2 tools and 2 fragments recovered.
24BH152  Temporary occupation site, 15 by 25 meters, with no artifacts found.
24BH153  Open occupation site, 75 by 20 meters, with few artifacts recovered.
24BH154  Rock art site, 1.5 by 20 meters, at base of cliff with several pictographs. No other materials found.
24BH155  A complex of open occupation sites along a rim, 100 by 100 meters, with heavy concentration of lithic materials.
24BH156  An open occupation site, 10 by 30 meters, with several artifacts found.
24BH157  A stine (tepee) ring, 10 by 10 meters area, with very sparse lighic materials.
24BH158  Open occupation site, 25 by 25 meters, with few fragments of artifacts recovered.
24BH159  Open occupation area, 100 by 200 meters, 11 artifacts recovered. A 45-70 cartridge case found in the area.
24BH160  Open occupation, 20 by 20 meters, with only 1 projectcile point found.
24BH161  A single time occupation, 24 by 40 meters, with scattering of lithic materials.
24BH162  Open occupation, 100 by 200 meters, with two fragmented artifacts found.
24BH163  Observation cairn on a high knoll with few flakes found.
